o.text: From Arabic غِذَاء (ḡiḏāʔ). Compare Turkish gıda.
From Proto-Turkic *sa(r)pan. Cognate with Turkish and Crimean Tatar saban, Bashkir һабан (haban), Chuvash сурбан (surban), etc.
From Proto-Turkic *ēĺ-. Cognate with Turkish eşmek, Chuvash алт (alt).
From the third-person singular possessed dative of əleyh, from Arabic عَلَيْهِ (ʕalayhi); əleyh + -inə.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قرغامق (qarġamaq), from Proto-Turkic *karga-. Compare Turkish kargımak, Crimean Tatar qarğamaq.
From Arabic فَقِير (faqīr) and its plural فُقَرَاء (fuqarāʔ). Equivalent to a synonymous compound of fağır + füqəra. Cognate with Turkish fakir fukara.
Internationalism; via Russian фотогра́фия (fotográfija), from Latin photographia, from Ancient Greek φωτός (phōtós, “(genitive) of light”) + γράφω (gráphō, “to write”).
